property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list, C always invokes the callee's transferFrom exactly once for each recipient in order starting with the first element; the mutant that starts the loop at i=1 omits the first recipient, so a recording callee will observe fewer calls when the first recipient is distinct and triggers the difference.
change_summary: Change the for-loop to start at i=1 instead of i=0 so the first recipient is skipped, changing the sequence of external calls and thus observable effects.
